remarks: An in-town gem ideally located near restaurants, shops, schools, and public transit - this home is sure to be snapped up! Relax on the wraparound front porch or unwind in the private backyard, complete with an additional outbuilding ideal for a home office, gym, or storage. Lovingly renovated, the home features a chef's kitchen at the heart of the open-concept great room, perfect for entertaining. Hardwood floors throughout, the second level offers two bedrooms, a full bath, and convenient laundry. The top floor is dedicated to a luxurious primary suite with walk-in closet and heated bathroom floors.
